content.short: Metronome Synth enables users to generate various synthetics with crypto assets as collateral.
content.description: Metronome Synth addresses the drawbacks of existing synthetic marketplaces, such as overcomplicated UIs, restricted synth generation, and limited capital efficiency. It builds an ecosystem designed to modernize the underdeveloped landscape and unlock greater potential for assets. Users can generate a variety of synthetic assets using crypto assets as collateral, enabling broader exposure and more efficient use of capital across supported networks.
